title: Kabsch / Umeyama: closed-form alignment
hints: Centre both sets: p̃ = p − p̄, q̃ = q − q̄. The optimal translation is t = q̄ − R p̄ (NOT q̄ − p̄).
H = Σ p̃ q̃ᵀ (3×3). `Eigen::JacobiSVD<Eigen::Matrix3d> svd(H, Eigen::ComputeFullU | Eigen::ComputeFullV);` then R = V Uᵀ.
Reflection: if det(V Uᵀ) < 0, use R = V · diag(1, 1, det(V Uᵀ)) · Uᵀ. This matters for planar or noisy data.
Umeyama scale: s = trace(diag(σ) · D) / Σ|p̃|², and t = q̄ − s R p̄.
